description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10008409/

Accept the call and handle motor vehicle accidents with the Motor Vehicle Accident Expansion for Firefighting Simulator: Ignite – adding new missions, new gameplay mechanics, new tools, and more. The Motor Vehicle Accident Expansion adds five additional main missions as well as more side missions to your experience. Firefighting Simulator: Ignite's biggest expansion also adds several new gameplay mechanics and techniques, including vehicle extrication, sawing, and plugging leaks to prevent further spillage. 

Use the hydraulic rescue tool to pry open car doors or tear apart collided and entangled motor vehicles. You will also need to use the rescue chainsaw to save lives. Extinguish fires and manage on-site hazards.  

The Motor Vehicle Accident Expansion is sold individually as DLC or can be downloaded with Year 1 Season Pass right now on PlayStation5.

#ps5 #ps5games #firefightingsimulatorignite
title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite - Motor Vehicle Accident Expansion Launch Trailer | PS5 Games

UNITED AGAINST FIRE. Face unpredictable dangers head-on, fight perilous fires with your crew and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter in a sprawling city in the American Midwest, where every mission pushes your skills to the limit. Experience the rush of firefighting in stunning visual quality in an intuitive and cooperative multiplayer mode with 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members. Join the crew now with PlayStation Plus and experience the thrill of being a firefighter first-hand.

During your career, cope with various challenging situations like trapped civilians, electric fires, flammable liquids, grease fires, backdrafts, flashovers and explosions.
